profile.headline:
Senior SWE Google
Independent Systematic Futures Researcher at Plaintape
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer and tech lead at Google Cloud, working on distributed storage for machine learning and data-intensive workloads. I've led engineering teams through service launches and built provisioning, lifecycle management, automated repair, monitoring and test infrastructure.

Alongside my engineering work, I independently research and operate a systematic futures strategy through Plaintape, built on Rob Carver's pysystemtrade. My research covers forecast combination, volatility estimation, covariance estimation and portfolio construction. I publish experiments and the reasons for adopting or rejecting an idea, including trading costs, uncertainty and its contribution to the existing portfolio.

I work primarily with Python, pandas, NumPy and SciPy for research, with experience across distributed systems, cloud infrastructure and automated testing. Earlier work at Google, Redfin and LendingClub included mobile SDKs, cross-platform test frameworks and A/B experiments.

I'm interested in quantitative research and research engineering roles where I can combine experiment design with building and operating reliable systems.

Research writing: https://plaintape.substack.com
Code: https://github.com/garcia42

positions.title: Independent Systematic Futures Researcher
positions.description:
Independent systematic futures research and live trading, beginning November 2025.

• Research forecast combination, volatility estimation, covariance estimation and portfolio construction using Python, pandas, NumPy and SciPy.
• Develop and operate a live futures system built on Rob Carver's pysystemtrade, covering forecasting, portfolio construction, execution, contract rolls and reconciliation through Interactive Brokers.
• Publish experiments, limitations and decisions about adopting or rejecting research ideas, considering trading costs, uncertainty and contribution to the existing portfolio.
• Build research and trading infrastructure with MongoDB, Parquet, GCP, Terraform and Docker.

Selected research:
https://plaintape.substack.com/p/why-i-am-not-using-machine-learning
https://plaintape.substack.com/p/event-time-price-segmentation-tested

Code: https://github.com/garcia42

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead for Google Cloud's Lustre high-performance storage service, supporting machine learning and data-intensive workloads.

• Led eight engineers through the service launch, working with data scientists and researchers on high-throughput storage requirements.
• Designed and implemented provisioning, instance lifecycle management, automated repair, monitoring and CI/CD.
• Served as interim engineering manager for two months in 2026 while continuing as tech lead, with responsibility for delivery, performance calibration and headcount planning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Google Cloud's NetApp storage offering.

• Led GCP-side architecture and implementation of a new storage tier, containerizing the NetApp filesystem to run on GCP infrastructure.
• Coordinated eight engineers to deliver more than 20 platform compliance requirements for enterprise launch.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led four engineers to integrate the Feed into Redfin's homepage, owning architecture and delivery.
• Ran desktop and mobile A/B experiments to measure engagement; evaluated Time to First Byte, First Paint and Time to Interactive against the existing homepage.
• Moved email sign-in logic from middleware to the backend to resolve cookie-related race conditions and share authentication logic with mobile clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built Android and iOS SDKs for Google Maps Platform's ridesharing and journey-sharing services.

• Led development of carpooling and multi-destination trip support in the iOS SDK, extending public APIs and journey-sharing animations.
• Designed and implemented a cross-platform RPC recording and replay framework for end-to-end SDK testing.
• Refactored Android and iOS codebases to use dependency injection, improving testability.
• Automated Android library builds and dependency packaging with Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and deployed a Spring Boot service for partner loan referrals, with a JavaScript and Node.js front end.
• Implemented A/B tests to measure the effect of loan-application UI changes on click-through.
• Built unit, functional and browser tests with JUnit, Mockito and Selenium.
• Coordinated cross-team delivery and blockers as the team's Scrum master.

positions.title: Android/iOS Development Intern
positions.description:
• Integrated an onboarding service in Swift that communicated with a RESTful api service.
• Implemented a new navigation control for viewing images by swiping in a custom ViewPager​ with
a pull up fragment (phone) or a NavigationDrawer​ (tablet) for details.
• Worked with Otto​, a square event bus library, for showing fragments and activities

positions.title: Android User Interface Intern
positions.description:
• In Java and XML, created a navigational structure for the application that allowed for fluid movement and functionality through managing fragments.
• Optimized the message board by 175% by recycling and storing references to views.
• Experience with location services and map activities/fragments.

projects.title: Volunteer Maps - Android
projects.description:
• Provides offline mode using Realm​ ​DB​ for local storage of volunteering opportunities
• Pulls data from the VolunteerMatch REST API and converts it into local java objects
• Uses Volley​ to manage queues of requests and refresh the​ ​RecyclerView
• Presents markers on a Google​ ​Map​ using clustering to show multiple groups of markers

projects.title: Settlers of Catan Web App
projects.description:
• Play the game, with a node.js backend that stores state of many games at a time
• Chat with other players with an in game chat box powered by socket.io
• Interact with the D3.js ui, a data visualization library, displaying the map backed by server data
